questions.q: With whom must the therapy be coordinated, according to Tanja?
questions.e: In the video: "moraš da se dogovoriš sa svojim endokrinologom" — you have to agree it with your endocrinologist.

questions.q: What did the mentioned study on gluten show?
o: With less gluten, antibodies decrease and vitamin D rises
questions.e: In the video: "kada se smanji unos glutena kod ljudi koji imaju Hashimoto" — when gluten intake is reduced in people who have Hashimoto's.
In the video: "Ima ga u žitaricama, pod jedan pšenica, zatim raž, ječam" — it's in grains: first wheat, then rye, barley.

questions.q: Which dairy products does Tanja advise keeping?
o: Fermented ones: kefir, yogurt, sour cream
questions.e: In the video: "ja savetujem da se oni zadrže u ishrani" — I advise keeping them in the diet.

questions.q: Which nut does Tanja recommend as a source of omega-3?
questions.e: In the video: "najobičniji naš orah je najbolji izvor omega-3" — our most ordinary walnut is the best source of omega-3.

questions.q: What should be done with cruciferous vegetables to lower goitrogens?
questions.e: In the video: "ukoliko skuvaš karfiol, brokoli i te kupusnjače" — if you boil cauliflower, broccoli and those cruciferous vegetables.

questions.q: Which supplement does Tanja call almost safe to take on your own?
questions.e: In the video: "bezbedno da uzimaš i na svoju ruku" — safe to take on your own too.

questions.q: What does Tanja advise at the end about lifestyle?
questions.e: In the video: "bolja kontrola stresa, kreni na terapiju" — better stress control, start therapy.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Autoimun — autoimmune.
Antitelo — an antibody.
Gluten — gluten.
Kiselo-mlečni — fermented-dairy.
Riba — fish.
Povrće — vegetables.
Suplement — a supplement.
Smanjiti — to reduce.

questions.q: Kod ljudi sa usporenim radom štitne ___ veće su šanse za celijakiju.
questions.e: Štitna žlezda in the genitive case: rad štitne žlezde.
Dogovoriti se sa + instrumental case: sa endokrinologom.
U + locative plural: u žitaricama.
Izbaciti + accusative case, neuter: kravlje mleko.
Što više + genitive case: domaće hrane.
Smetati + dative case: smetaju štitnoj žlezdi.
Intolerancija na + accusative case: na laktozu.

questions.q: Ukoliko nemaš ___, možeš da jedeš ovas.
questions.e: Imati + accusative case: nemaš celijakiju — "you don't have celiac disease".
